name: WhisperX
notes: 2026-11-01: faster-whisper ASR with forced alignment for word timestamps and optional diarisation.
2026-11-01: CPU-only on Apple Silicon; ML output drifts across versions, so commit alignment JSON as fixtures.
2026-11-15: v3.8.7rc1 is newer but prerelease; card and last_release identify the latest stable release. Diarization requires separate gated model access; model terms are not the code licence.
summary: Python CLI and library for batched automatic speech recognition with word-level timestamps, forced alignment, VAD and optional speaker diarization. It uses faster-whisper/Whisper and wav2vec2 alignment models; model downloads, accelerator stack and gated pyannote access for diarization add setup constraints. Its distinguishing strength is combining transcription and word alignment in one local workflow.
use_when: Generate word-timed transcripts from audio with local model inference
Use when forced alignment and optional speaker diarization justify the larger model stack
avoid_when: Need lightweight transcription without word alignment: use whisper-cpp
Use Rhubarb Lip Sync when output should be mouth-shape cues rather than transcript words
license: BSD-2-Clause (code); pretrained models and gated diarization models carry separate terms/access requirements

install.macos: uv tool install whisperx (follow upstream platform and PyTorch guidance; model downloads required)

assessment.rationale: WhisperX v3.8.6 released 2026-05-25 and the official repository shows active 2026 issues and pull requests; v3.8.7rc1 is a later prerelease. Code is BSD-2-Clause; pretrained and gated diarization models have separate terms/access.
